3.4 Catchfan

3.4.1 Requirements
The Code states that catchfans shall be used only as precautionary measures and shall not be used as
temporary support for any anticipated loads, In the industry, generally additional temporary timber catch
fans are provided inside the bamboo scaffolding and the gap between the scaffolding and building face to
collect and safe guard of falling debris qenerated during the cutting of slots through the external walls and
trimming at the bottom of the columns far felling.

Bamboo Catchfan

(Ay Framing
When the bamboo cannat be extended into the building in the case where there is no window or
wall opening, additional means of supporting the catchfan should be included and shown in the
demolition plan. EH-Figure 3.3-2 shows some alternative suggested details.

(B) Decking
Please refer to the Code,

Steel Catchfan

Consideration should be given to prevent falling objects when openings are to be punched or cored through
the extemal wall, particularly abutting the boundary line, for the installation of the cantilever steel
sections. Bamboo scaffolding may need to be erected as a temporary protection measure for the erection
of the steel platform.
